info.name: Feedly - Hacker Green | Dark
info.description: Transform Feedly into a green hacker terminal with a subtle embedded emerald cyber-grid wallpaper and floating translucent glass sidebars, feed cards, toolbars, menus, and reader panels. Features glowing Matrix-green headings, mint article text, neon hover effects, green scrollbars, and retro Google Fonts typography: Share Tech Mono for the interface and VT323 for titles and prominent headings. The JPEG wallpaper is embedded inside the stylesheet; the two fonts are imported from Google Fonts with local fallbacks. Uses the userstyles.org classic Mozilla-format @-moz-document wrapper.
